name: The Core
description: Ixalan's legendary Core where the Oltecs live.

description_citations.text: "Quintorius". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world matching her visions.
timeline.quote: A sprawling panorama spread before, above, and around her as she stepped through the portal.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia sees the central sun ringed by metal shards, as in her vision.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all, a strange sun hovered

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim Pakal arrives on a bat and demands to know how the seal was opened.
timeline.quote: I am called Anim Pakal

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo explains the plan to isolate and defeat the Mycotyrant has failed.
timeline.quote: The plan to isolate and defeat it has failed.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim accuses the visitors of bringing ruin by opening the door.
timeline.quote: You have brought ruin to us.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim explains that the Komon were Oltec ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.
timeline.quote: The Komon are our ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: When a soldier announces the Legion are vampires, Anim orders them imprisoned as worshippers of the Great Betrayer.
timeline.quote: Worshippers of the Great Betrayer are not welcome here

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito goes into a trance and says all proceeds according to Aclazotz's will.
timeline.quote: All proceeds according to his will

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal Pakal receives the Sun Empire group and raises the presence of vampires.
timeline.quote: I have heard some of your story from my sister Anim

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti and Caparocti urge the Oltec to help strike Torrezon while Huatli argues for peace.
timeline.quote: Now is the perfect time to strike.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo tells Quint the khipu was Abuela's and Quint proposes bringing her back as an Echo.
timeline.quote: Perhaps we can bring her back, as I helped you come back.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Legion is locked in empty detention rooms, weapons confiscated.
timeline.quote: Even so, the Legion vampires and their few remaining servants were locked up in empty rooms, weapons confiscated, and left to await their fates.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan questions the vampires, and Amalia defends the church's blood rites, then doubts.
timeline.quote: We only feed from criminals, evil people, and we use the power of blood to help others.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan reveals he is searching for the father he has never met.
timeline.quote: I'm searching for my father

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito conjures a thick magical fog over the building.
timeline.quote: A magical fog covered the building, so thick her hand would disappear if she thrust it through the opening.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia smells blood as the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants.
timeline.quote: When the scent of blood reached her, Amalia feared the worst.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé makes Amalia promise to return to Queen Miralda and tell her everything if he dies.
timeline.quote: if something happens to me, you must return to Queen Miralda. Tell her everything.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño tears off the door and Vito enters, bloodstained.
timeline.quote: A crimson handprint was smeared down the front of his armor

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice to Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: The blood of the outsider will suffice

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé attacks Vito to block the doorway while Kellan summons his swords.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé leaped at Vito, hands curled into claws, fangs bared.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito breaks Bartolomé's neck and kills him.
timeline.quote: Vito locked an arm around Bartolomé's head and twisted, the terrible snap echoing in the small room.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia erases the wall from her map; mist rolls in and she and Kellan flee.
timeline.quote: The wall behind her vanished.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint watches Sun Empire warriors and Oltec riders prepare for a coming-of-age flight.
timeline.quote: He watched the Sun Empire warriors don special harnesses, supervised by members of the Thousand Moons.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal tells Quint that stories are the memory of the plane and mentions the Night War.
timeline.quote: Stories are the memory of the plane, and to forget is to succumb to darkness.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli returns with a fragment of cosmium.
timeline.quote: I found a fragment!

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta reports that the vampires have summoned a bigger cloud of cursed fog.
timeline.quote: The vampires have summoned a cloud of their cursed fog, bigger than usual.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim brings in two prisoners, Amalia and Kellan.
timeline.quote: We found these two running from the garrison

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia says the other vampires killed their servants and the queen's emissary and are seeking Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: They killed our human servants and the queen's emissary, then escaped. They're looking for Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim and Akal react with fear, saying Aclazotz has been imprisoned for ages and some Oltec may still worship him.
timeline.quote: If the vampires find these allies, they may at last be powerful enough to release the bat god from his prison.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito reflects that he has taken revenge on Bartolomé and leads the vampires through the fog.
timeline.quote: Despite Bartolomé thwarting his intended sacrifice, he'd finally had his revenge on that thorn of the Black Rose.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño and the soldiers hunt and feed on Oltec in the fog.
timeline.quote: Clavileño and the other soldiers found and silenced some, gorging themselves in an ecstasy of blood.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A red-lit guide offers to lead Vito to Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: I have been sent to guide you to Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito learns that Aclazotz is a prisoner and feels doubt, then pride.
timeline.quote: Vito faltered at the mention of imprisonment.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito places the pink crystal key into the door, enduring pain, and the door opens.
timeline.quote: Crimson light spread to the glyphs around the door, and it rolled sideways with a deep rumbling sound.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito enters an amphitheater of worshippers.
timeline.quote: a thousand pale faces turned to watch Vito enter.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sees Aclazotz chained with golden chains inlaid with cosmium crystals.
timeline.quote: The bat god crouched on the floor, shrouded by his wings and wrapped in loops of thick golden chains inlaid with hundreds of pink crystals.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
timeline.quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prisoners are fed to Aclazotz, and his eye brightens with each death.
timeline.quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz breaks his golden chains.
timeline.quote: A concussive burst of magic struck everyone in the room as the gold links snapped in a dozen places.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz bites Vito and blesses the others, transforming them into bat creatures.
timeline.quote: In a flash, he sank them deep into Vito's neck and torso.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The transformed vampires stand as bat-like monsters.
timeline.quote: Where once vampires had knelt, new creatures stood, their forms echoing their master's.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prison's shadow darkens the Core.
timeline.quote: The shadow of that prison fell across the land, enshrouding it in a darkness deeper than any night in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz demands more sacrifices and Vito shrieks the order to the Legion.
timeline.quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta panics at the darkening sun and is reminded of the Phyrexian war.
timeline.quote: The sun darkened, and Wayta fought the urge to panic, cold sweat pooling in the small of her back.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm flies into the Core and finds a battle already underway.
timeline.quote: there appeared to be another battle already in progress.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta meet in the air and exchange news of the mushroom horde and the bat monsters.
timeline.quote: The vampires have transformed into bat monsters and their god imprisoned the sun.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal says Anim is mobilizing the Thousand Moons, but forces will be stretched thin by two threats.
timeline.quote: My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense, but between this and Aclazotz, our forces will be spread thin.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli cradles Inti's dead body as battle rages above.
timeline.quote: Huatli cradled the broken body of her cousin, kneeling in the blood-spattered soil of a land far from home.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Transformed Vito arrives to capture Huatli for Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz will be pleased when I deliver you to him

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
timeline.quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli calls on the land's magic as she fights Vito.
timeline.quote: She called to the mountains and forests, the fields and valleys.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli twists Vito's lance out of his hand.
timeline.quote: She caught it in the gap of her shield, twisting the weapon out of his hand.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Dinosaurs, including Pantlaza, swarm Vito.
timeline.quote: A flying dinosaur barreled into him, sending him tumbling to the ground.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli kills Vito with his own lance through the heart.
timeline.quote: The lance slid through the vampire's plate armor, piercing his vile heart and pinning him to the ground.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito dies asking Aclazotz why he forsook him.
timeline.quote: why have you forsaken me?

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli promises Inti she will return after every vampire in the Core is eradicated.
timeline.quote: promising Inti that she would return when every vampire in the Core was eradicated.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm recalls that Vraska reportedly died in the invasion.
timeline.quote: She'd died in the invasion, or so he'd heard.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint and Abuelo restore Abuela as an Echo, who warns that the Mycotyrant nears.
timeline.quote: Everyone, this is Abuela.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The gardeners arrive and summon Echoes anchored to heirloom objects.
timeline.quote: Spirits burst into existence, anchored to the items.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Akal sends the gardeners to preserve the land while the Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil.
timeline.quote: While our Thousand Moons fight to save Chimil, you must preserve the land for their return.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia offers to help by using her map magic on the land.
timeline.quote: I can change the land with my map.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia carves a fissure in front of the Mycotyrant's army.
timeline.quote: a deep crevice lay in the path of the army, encircling them so retreat would be difficult.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The mycoids bridge the fissure with their own bodies.
timeline.quote: soon a thick bridge spanned the crevice.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Echoes destroy mycoids by entering them as a counter-infection.
timeline.quote: It dissolved into blue smoke as if consumed by invisible fire.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Gardeners burn mycoids with waves of pink light.
timeline.quote: Every fungus the light touched burst into flames.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Breeches pulls out a flowery tube weapon he got in High and Dry.
timeline.quote: From his pack, he retrieved the weapon he'd acquired in High and Dry as payment for a debt.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Breeches fires a molten fireball that fells a titan and sends the colony into disarray.
timeline.quote: Every fungal creature around it shrieked in unison, some collapsing like puppets whose strings had been cut.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The casing around the sun shifts apart and light shines through again.
timeline.quote: As the dust cleared, the casing around the sun shifted apart slowly, almost imperceptibly.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta spots a temple of Aclazotz revealed in a sheared mountain face.
timeline.quote: Pillars of a great temple rose from the sheared mountain face.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Anim sends the Thousand Moons to destroy the cosmium eaters.
timeline.quote: My Moons, come. We will root out the disease of cosmium eaters and end them as well.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan beheads a vampire while Amalia looks away.
timeline.quote: bringing his sword together like scissors, Kellan took off her head.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Thousand Moons find the temple empty and Aclazotz gone.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz is gone

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A captured cosmium eater says Aclazotz is free and will end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: He gathers his children, and soon he will end the Fifth Age and begin a new age of blood.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The eater calls Amalia a traitor for abandoning Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Traitor. We saw you run when you were called.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia grieves Bartolomé's death and Vito's rightness about their god.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé died to protect her and Kellan, but his sacrifice was in vain.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6

timeline.summary: A mortal of the Fourth People, afraid of death, slaughters his people, drinks their blood, and kills the final god as it emerges, becoming the bat god Aclazotz.
